function.name: search_spaces
function.description: Search for live or scheduled X Spaces by keyword or topic. Returns a short spoken summary and raw results.

state.description: Filter by Space state. Default live.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-10 recommended).

function.name: get_space_details
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific Space by its ID, including hosts and speakers when available.

space_id.description: The Space ID returned from a previous search.

function.name: confirm_selection
function.description: Finalize the caller's choice of Space. Returns the join URL and confirmation message.

mode.description: Discovery (link) or full audio bridge mode. Default link.
